---
title: "Data build (Steps 0-8)"
format: html
---

The do-files that build the person-day data set, in the order `Do Main do file.do` runs them, with Main first. Click a file to open it. Patient-level corrections are removed ([why](stata_overview.qmd#privacy)).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| output: asis
# Reads the do-files as text; runs no analysis.
source("_show_stata.R")
show_do_file("Do Main do file.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 0B Current Regimen.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 1A Pharmacy Part 1.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 2 CD4.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 3 VL.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 4 Demographic.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 4B Insurance.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 4C Psych.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 5 Merge and Expand.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 6 Tokenize Pharmacy.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 7 Merge Pharmacy.do")
show_do_file("Do Step 8 Data Preparation.do")
```
